ya10.3.4:1.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānāti so domanassindriyaṃ pajahitthā’ti: āmantā.
ya10.3.4:2.1: yo vā pana domanassindriyaṃ pajahittha so cakkhundriyaṃ parijānātī’ti:
ya10.3.4:3.1: dveva puggalā domanassindriyaṃ pajahittha, no ca cakkhundriyaṃ parijānanti. aggamaggasamaṅgī domanassindriyañca pajahittha, cakkhundriyañca parijānāti.
ya10.3.4:4.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānāti so anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvitthā’ti: āmantā.
ya10.3.4:5.1: yo vā pana anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvittha so cakkhundriyaṃ parijānātī’ti:
ya10.3.4:6.1: cha puggalā anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvittha, no ca cakkhundriyaṃ parijānanti. aggamaggasamaṅgī anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca bhāvittha, cakkhundriyañca parijānāti.
ya10.3.4:7.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānāti so aññindriyaṃ bhāvitthā’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:8.1: yo vā pana aññindriyaṃ bhāvittha so cakkhundriyaṃ parijānātī’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:9.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānāti so aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikaritthā’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:10.1: yo vā pana aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikarittha so cakkhundriyaṃ parijānātī’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:11.1: yo domanassindriyaṃ pajahati so anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvitthā’ti: āmantā.
ya10.3.4:12.1: yo vā pana anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvittha so domanassindriyaṃ pajahatī’ti:
ya10.3.4:13.1: cha puggalā anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvittha, no ca domanassindriyaṃ pajahanti. anāgāmimaggasamaṅgī anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca bhāvittha, domanassindriyañca pajahati.
ya10.3.4:14.1: yo domanassindriyaṃ pajahati so aññindriyaṃ bhāvitthā’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:15.1: yo vā pana aññindriyaṃ bhāvittha so domanassindriyaṃ pajahatī’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:16.1: yo domanassindriyaṃ pajahati so aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikaritthā’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:17.1: yo vā pana aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikarittha so domanassindriyaṃ pajahatī’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:18.1: yo anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāveti so aññindriyaṃ bhāvitthā’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:19.1: yo vā pana aññindriyaṃ bhāvittha so anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvetī’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:20.1: yo anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāveti so aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikaritthā’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:21.1: yo vā pana aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikarittha so anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvetī’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:22.1: yo aññindriyaṃ bhāveti so aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikaritthā’ti: no.
ya10.3.4:23.1: yo vā pana aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikarittha so aññindriyaṃ bhāvetī’ti: no: (anulomaṃ)
ya10.3.4:24.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānāti so domanassindriyaṃ nappajahitthā’ti:
ya10.3.4:25.1: dve puggalā cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānanti. no ca domanassindriyaṃ nappajahittha, cha puggalā cakkhundriyañca na parijānanti, domanassindriyañca nappajahittha.
ya10.3.4:26.1: yo vā pana domanassindriyaṃ nappajahittha so cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānātī’ti: āmantā.
ya10.3.4:27.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānāti so anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāvitthā’ti:
ya10.3.4:28.1: cha puggalā cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāvittha. dve puggalā cakkhundriyañca na parijānanti. anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca na bhāvittha.
ya10.3.4:29.1: yo vā pana anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāvittha so cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānātī’ti: āmantā.
ya10.3.4:30.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānāti so aññindriyaṃ na bhāvitthā’ti:
ya10.3.4:31.1: arahā cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānāti, no ca aññindriyaṃ na bhāvittha. satta puggalā cakkhundriyañca na parijānanti, aññindriyañca na bhāvittha.
ya10.3.4:32.1: yo vā pana aññindriyaṃ na bhāvittha so cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānātī’ti:
ya10.3.4:33.1: aggamaggasamaṅgī aññindriyaṃ na bhāvittha, no ca cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānāti. sattapuggalā aññindriyañca na bhāvittha, cakkhundriyañca na parijānanti.
ya10.3.4:34.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānāti so aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikaritthā’ti:
ya10.3.4:35.1: arahā cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānāti, no ca aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha, aṭṭhapuggalā cakkhundriyañca na parijānanti, aññātāvindriyañca na sacchikarittha.
ya10.3.4:36.1: yo vā pana aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha so cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānātī’ti:
ya10.3.4:37.1: aggamaggasamaṅgī aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha, no ca cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānāti. aṭṭhapuggalā aññātāvindriyañca na sacchikarittha, cakkhundriyañca na parijānanti.
ya10.3.4:38.1: yo domanassindriyaṃ nappajahati so anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāvitthā’ti:
ya10.3.4:39.1: cha puggalā domanassindriyaṃ nappajahanti. no ca anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāvittha. dve puggalā domanassindriyañca nappajahanti. anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca na bhāvittha.
ya10.3.4:40.1: yo vā pana anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāvittha so domanassindriyaṃ nappajahatī’ti: āmantā.
ya10.3.4:41.1: yo domanassindriyaṃ nappajahati so aññindriyaṃ na bhāvitthā’ti:
ya10.3.4:42.1: arahā domanassindriyaṃ nappajahati, no ca aññindriyaṃ na bhāvittha, satta puggalā domanassindriyañca nappajanti, aññindriyañca na bhāvittha.
ya10.3.4:43.1: yo vā pana aññindriyaṃ na bhāvittha so domanassindriyaṃ nappajahatī’ti:
ya10.3.4:44.1: anāgāmī maggasamaṅgī aññindriyaṃ na bhāvittha, no ca domanassindriyaṃ nappajahati. sattapuggalā aññindriyañca na bhāvittha, domanassindriyañca nappajahanti.
ya10.3.4:45.1: yo domanassindriyaṃ nappajahati so aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikaritthā’ti:
ya10.3.4:46.1: arahā domanassindriyaṃ nappajahati, no ca aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha. aṭṭha puggalā domanassindriyañca nappajahanti, aññātāvindriyañca na sacchikarittha.
ya10.3.4:47.1: yo vā pana aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha so domanassindriyaṃ nappajahatī’ti:
ya10.3.4:48.1: anāgāmī maggasamaṅgī aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha, no ca domanassindriyaṃ nappajahati. aṭṭhapuggalā aññātāvindriyañca na sacchikarittha, domanassindriyañca nappajahanti.
ya10.3.4:49.1: yo anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāveti so aññindriyaṃ na bhāvitthā’ti:
ya10.3.4:50.1: arahā anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāveti, no ca aññindriyaṃ na bhāvittha. satta puggalā anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca na bhāventi, aññindriyañca na bhāvittha.
ya10.3.4:51.1: yo vā pana aññindriyaṃ na bhāvittha so anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāvetī’ti:
ya10.3.4:52.1: aṭṭhamako aññindriyaṃ na bhāvittha, no ca anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāveti. satta puggalā aññindriyañca na bhāvittha, anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca na bhāventi.
ya10.3.4:53.1: yo anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāveti so aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikaritthā’ti:
ya10.3.4:54.1: arahā anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāveti, no ca aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha. satta puggalā anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca na bhāventi. aññātāvindriyañca na sacchikarittha.
ya10.3.4:55.1: yo vā pana aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha so anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāvetī’ti:
ya10.3.4:56.1: aṭṭhamako aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha, no ca anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na bhāveti, satta puggalā aññātāvindriyañca na sacchikarittha, anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca na bhāventi.
ya10.3.4:57.1: yo aññindriyaṃ na bhāveti so aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikaritthā’ti:
ya10.3.4:58.1: arahā aññindriyaṃ na bhāveti, no ca aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha. pañca puggalā aññindriyañca na bhāventi, aññātāvindriyañca na sacchikarittha.
ya10.3.4:59.1: yo vā pana aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha so aññindriyaṃ na bhāvetī’ti:
ya10.3.4:60.1: tayo maggasamaṅgī aññātāvindriyaṃ na sacchikarittha, no ca aññindriyaṃ na bhāventi. pañca puggalā aññātāvindriyañca na sacchikarittha, aññindriyañca na bhāventi. (paccanīkaṃ). paccuppannātītavāro.
